verdict.rationale:
Phaser Studio ships an official 'Phaser Game Agent' MCP server with 40+ specialized tools that integrates with Claude Desktop, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other MCP clients, letting an agent create particle emitters, reorganize scenes into layers, rename objects, tweak physics/animations, and add filters via natural-language commands routed through documented tool calls — directly matching the 'agent drives the editor programmatically' story. Runtime probe confirms the hosted MCP endpoint is live and documented at phaser.io/agent/mcp.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification that the MCP tools reliably perform builds/edits, and a published open API/tool reference (npm package) beyond the marketing page.
